title: autodiff: avoid need for -Zautodiff flag
author: ZuseZ4
body_preview: Currently we there are two blockers for using std::autodiff - we require setting `lto=fat` and we require `RUSTFLAGS=-Zautodiff=Enable`.  There's an open issue to get rid of the lto requirement, this one is about the -Z flag.  The reason we need both lies in our compilation model.
